en.title: Mayfair Witches Season 3 Arrives December 30: Zeta-Jones Teases 'Kill Jackie'
en.summary: Get ready to dive back into the gothic world of the Mayfair witches. AMC has officially announced the premiere date for the highly anticipated third season, and the cast is already hinting at dark developments.
en.body:
The wait is almost over for fans of **Anne Rice's Mayfair Witches**. AMC has officially set Wednesday, December 30, for the premiere of **Mayfair Witches: Salem Coven**, the show's third season. This announcement arrived alongside tantalizing hints from the cast at New York Comic Con, with stars like **Catherine Zeta-Jones** and **Carrie-Anne Moss** teasing a potentially explosive season ahead.

At NYCC, the network offered a first look at the upcoming season, giving attendees an exclusive teaser trailer that promises more mystery, magic, and danger for the powerful witch family. The panel, which included co-showrunners **Esta Spalding** and **Tom Schnauz**, as well as executive producer **Mark Johnson**, highlighted the series' commitment to bringing Rice's complex supernatural lore to life. The presence of **Alexandra Daddario**, **Harry Hamlin**, **Tongayi Chirisa**, **Betsy Brandt**, and **Eliza Scanlen** further solidified the ensemble's strength as they prepare to delve deeper into the Mayfair legacy.

## Unveiling the Salem Coven's Next Chapter

The third season, subtitled **Salem Coven**, is poised to expand the narrative, bringing new challenges and potentially darker forces into play. While specific plot details remain under wraps, the cryptic teases from the cast have fueled fan speculation. **Catherine Zeta-Jones**, who portrays the enigmatic matriarch **Lasher**, and **Carrie-Anne Moss**, as the formidable **Julien Mayfair**, have hinted at intense confrontations and significant turning points. The phrase 'Kill Jackie' was reportedly mentioned, suggesting a high-stakes plotline that will undoubtedly keep viewers on the edge of their seats and fuel endless fan theories about who 'Jackie' might be and why they are targeted.

## Fan Frenzy and Anticipation Builds

Fans have been eagerly awaiting news on the third season since the second concluded, and the December 30 premiere date is a welcome confirmation. The blend of gothic atmosphere, family drama, and supernatural intrigue that **Mayfair Witches** offers has cultivated a dedicated fanbase. The involvement of such esteemed actresses as **Zeta-Jones** and **Moss**, coupled with the rich source material from **Anne Rice**, ensures that each new season is met with immense anticipation. The hints of 'Kill Jackie' and the introduction of what sounds like a powerful antagonist known as 'Yaga' suggest that the **Salem Coven** will face threats unlike any they have encountered before, raising the stakes considerably for the entire Mayfair lineage.

## What's Next

Mark your calendars for December 30th as **Anne Rice's Mayfair Witches: Salem Coven** officially premieres on AMC. With the season premiere date confirmed and the cast hinting at dramatic twists, fans can expect a bewitching return to the world of the Mayfairs.

content_raw: AMC Global Media teased four series on its Friday afternoon panel, which also featured never-before-seen footage from 'The Walking Dead: Daryl Dixon.'
